parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the two switch buttons on the wall switch, made of ABS plastic with a smooth surface for easy pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main actuator for turning an electrical circuit on or off when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It moves by pivoting or depressing slightly inward when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second switch button on the wall switch, also made of ABS plastic and designed for tactile operation.
parts.Functional_description: It controls a separate electrical circuit, allowing independent operation of two connected devices or lights.
parts.Movement_description: It moves similarly to the first switch, pivoting or depressing inward when pressed and returning to its neutral position.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or frame of the wall switch, made of durable polycarbonate plastic that holds the switches and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the electrical contacts and wiring connections for the switch mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall, serving as the mounting and protective enclosure for the switch assembly.
